entries.name: logging camp
entries.description: An eighty metre timber yard: several modest timber shelters with broad dark roofs, long neat log stacks and a crane. Most parcel area is working yard, not oversized lodge.

entries.name: sawmill
entries.description: An eighty metre sawmill compound: long low saw halls with broad red roofs, open timber-loading sheds and a few large log stacks. Six distinct modest truck bays.

entries.name: coal mine
entries.description: An eighty metre coal mine: tall clear dark winding tower, two low scale-correct mine workshops, conveyors and a few broad charcoal coal heaps.

entries.name: iron mine
entries.description: An eighty metre iron mine: clear winding tower, ore sorting sheds, brown-red ore heaps and long conveyors. Small ordinary doors.

entries.name: steel mill
entries.description: An eighty metre steel mill: several long red-brick furnace halls, tall broad chimneys and large blast furnaces. Small ordinary doors and repeated loading bays.

entries.name: farm
entries.description: A grain farm with a low barn cluster and one tall silo. For a five-tile site, broad grain fields surround a small central two-tile farmyard; for a two-tile core, ONLY the barn, silo and simple farmyard are shown.

entries.name: food plant
entries.description: An eighty metre food processing compound: multiple long low cream halls with broad green roofs, several silver silos and four loading docks.

entries.name: furniture factory
entries.description: An eighty metre furniture works: three connected brick production wings with broad slate roofs, simple lumber stock and four loading docks.

entries.name: machine works
entries.description: An eighty metre engineering works: multiple long cream halls with broad blue roofs, a crane court, a few large machined metal pieces. Six normal truck-size loading bays.

direction: Each sprite is a full fixed-scale parcel seen from the same camera. Keep a large transparent border, no shadows crossing the cell. The ground parcel is a broad 2:1 diamond, centered horizontally; its FRONT point lies at90percent cell height. A5tile compound is80m wide, personnel doors must be tiny4.5px high in a256px cell, loading bays9px high. Make buildings into several long wings rather than a giant single cottage. Prioritize large roof masses and industry silhouette. No textures made of tiny high-contrast marks.
